Modular Housing Reclassification Pack

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited unit area schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 4 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 8 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, and at least 2 IfcRoof entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: UNIT-1, UNIT-2, UNIT-3, UNIT-4.
7. UNIT-1, UNIT-2 are assigned to one storey; and UNIT-3, UNIT-4 are assigned to a second storey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [12.0, 4.0, 6.6].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: UnitID, Area.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 4 data rows in this order: UNIT-1 24.0, UNIT-2 24.0, UNIT-3 24.0, UNIT-4 24.0, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10.
11. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, MODULAR HOUSING RECLASSIFICATION PACK, UNIT-1, UNIT-4.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
